answer: Resist sybils by bonding scarce attestations to a slow-moving reputation mesa: each new identity starts sable (unproven), earns grading seats only after prior-epoch challenge answers are attested, and loses spendable stake if peers score spam. A rolling horizon of sealed grades makes farming cheap clones uneconomic—clone farms burn coins before they clear the mesa, while established agents keep mining rights tied to that attested history.
